# Now 2.10.64
- Added an optional Live Lyrics media tile in Settings → Artwork & Lyrics. - Synchronized lyric lines stay aligned between browser metadata updates and animate smoothly as the song advances. - Lyrics matching is deliberately conservative and automatically falls back to album art when synchronized timing is unavailable. - Added reduced-motion support, bounded caching, request timeouts, and track-change cancellation for efficient background behavior. - Moved update checks to the stable public feed file instead of GitHub's stale-prone latest-release redirect.

# Now 2.10.63
- Added an optional Live Lyrics media tile in Settings → Artwork & Lyrics. - Synchronized lyric lines stay aligned between browser metadata updates and animate smoothly as the song advances. - Lyrics matching is deliberately conservative and automatically falls back to album art when synchronized timing is unavailable. - Added reduced-motion support, bounded caching, request timeouts, and track-change cancellation for efficient background behavior.

# Now 2.10.62
- Fixed the long-running stall that could leave the overlay showing an old song while YouTube Music continued playing. - Chrome extension updates now drive the overlay directly, with AppleScript retained as an automatic fallback. - Native music app probes now run concurrently with hard deadlines, so an unresponsive paused app cannot freeze Now. - Playback controls now rediscover the matching YouTube Music tab after a transport reset instead of showing “Open YouTube Music.” - The Chrome extension listener automatically restarts if its loopback connection fails. - Added Restart Now to the menu bar for a safe, one-click full relaunch.
